claims.text: Pathway: SA node, internodal pathways, AV node, AV bundle, right and left bundle branches, Purkinje fibers.
claims.quote: Specialized conducting components of the heart include the sinoatrial node, the internodal pathways, the atrioventricular node, the atrioventricular bundle, the right and left bundle branches, and the Purkinje fibers.
claims.locator: Figure 19.18 Conduction System of the Heart

claims.text: SA node: the pacemaker, in the superior and posterior right atrial wall near the opening of the superior vena cava; it has the highest inherent rate of depolarization.
claims.quote: Normal cardiac rhythm is established by the sinoatrial (SA) node, a specialized clump of myocardial conducting cells located in the superior and posterior walls of the right atrium in close proximity to the orifice of the superior vena cava. The SA node has the highest inherent rate of depolarization and is known as the pacemaker of the heart.

claims.text: AV node as the gate: the cardiac skeleton keeps the impulse out of the ventricles except at the AV node.
claims.quote: as the impulse reaches the atrioventricular septum, the connective tissue of the cardiac skeleton prevents the impulse from spreading into the myocardial cells in the ventricles except at the atrioventricular node.

claims.text: AV delay: about 100 ms, letting the atria finish pumping before the impulse reaches the AV bundle.
claims.quote: After reaching the atrioventricular node, there is a delay of approximately 100 ms that allows the atria to complete pumping blood before the impulse is transmitted to the atrioventricular bundle.

claims.text: Bundle of His: runs through the interventricular septum and divides into the left and right bundle branches; the left bundle branch has two fascicles.
claims.quote: the atrioventricular bundle, or bundle of His, proceeds through the interventricular septum before dividing into two atrioventricular bundle branches, commonly called the left and right bundle branches. The left bundle branch has two fascicles.
claims.locator: Atrioventricular Bundle (Bundle of His), Bundle Branches, and Purkinje Fibers

claims.text: Bundle branches: the left supplies the left ventricle and the right the right ventricle; the left is considerably larger.
claims.quote: The left bundle branch supplies the left ventricle, and the right bundle branch the right ventricle. Since the left ventricle is much larger than the right, the left bundle branch is also considerably larger than the right.
claims.locator: Atrioventricular Bundle (Bundle of His), Bundle Branches, and Purkinje Fibers
